observation_summary: The application throws a JsonMappingException with 'Operation not supported' when attempting to serialize binary data using an InputStream, because the ToXmlGenerator class lacks an implementation for the writeBinary(Base64Variant, InputStream, int) method.
hypothesis: The ToXmlGenerator class is missing a required capability (the writeBinary method for InputStreams) that is expected by the Jackson serialization framework, causing it to fall back to an unsupported operation.
prediction: Implementing the missing writeBinary method in ToXmlGenerator, along with helper methods to read the InputStream into a buffer, will resolve the UnsupportedOperationException.
experiment_rationale: The fix diff shows the addition of a completely new method 'writeBinary' and supporting helper methods to 'ToXmlGenerator'. This is a structural addition of a missing capability rather than a correction of existing logic.
reasoning_summary: The bug is classified as Function/Class/Object because the fix involves implementing a missing capability (the writeBinary method for InputStreams) that was entirely absent from the class. It is not an Algorithm/Method issue because the logic for the method did not exist to be corrected; it is not a Checking issue because the error was not due to a missing guard, but a missing implementation of an interface-required method.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The fix is not correcting an existing faulty algorithm, but adding a missing capability that was never implemented.
The error is not caused by a missing guard or validation, but by the absence of the required method implementation.
